notes.title: STEAM AWARDS 2023
notes.content:
Astebros is a roguelite game that tells the story of the early kingdom of Asteborg!
Choose your hero from three different characters and traverse procedural dungeons to eliminate your formidable opponents!

Defeat bosses to obtain precious power orbs!

Collect coins and materials to buy and upgrade your equipment!

Discover mysterious secrets in the dungeons...

Alone or in pairs!
